decisions.decision: Deletion keeps exactly one ledger entry per deleted account outside the database being restored: the keyed login-identity hash and the deletion time, nothing else. An entry is purged 30 days after the deletion, and never while a backup taken before that deletion still exists.

(1) GPU processing is allowed and preferred to CPU for the vision path itself (capture post-processing and local model inference); Dota 2 leaves VRAM room by the owner's account. (2) NO RAM or VRAM limit is set. The earlier figures (the 900,000,000-byte Working Set ceiling of DEC-BASELINE, withdrawn here and not replaced, and the owner's rough 2 GB, which is not a limit) apply to nothing. (3) QUALITY-002 keeps the CPU cap (at most 10 percent per 1 s normalized sample, unchanged) and requires the app-group full Working Set and, when the GPU is used, VRAM to be MEASURED AND REPORTED with raw receipts, with no pass/fail limit until the owner sets one from the first baseline. A value that was not measured is unknown, never zero or within budget. No measurement exists: new_build_status stays NOT_RUN. Capture stays DXGI Desktop Duplication (REMAINING-SYSTEM-DESIGN D1); no other threshold changed.
open_questions: Which RAM number and which VRAM number does the owner set after the first baseline (idle, live and voice-alert profiles)?
Does a RAM limit cover the whole application group including WebView2 and sidecars (as QUALITY-002 defines the process set)?

decisions.safe_interim: Measure and report RAM (full Working Set) and, when the GPU is used, VRAM per process with raw receipts; apply and claim no RAM or VRAM limit; never present an unmeasured value as within budget. No model, vision path or GPU feature is approved by this decision.
decisions.closure_evidence: The first measured baseline of app-group full Working Set and VRAM for the idle, live and voice-alert profiles on the certified configuration, reported by receipts (the GPU memory counters are UNVERIFIED as a measurement method and need a stated method first); after that the owner sets the limit(s) and this decision is closed by a recorded number, the runtime-status contract and QUALITY-002 being amended together.

decisions.decision: GO for a local draft bar: capture the top hero bar during HERO_SELECTION, STRATEGY_TIME and TEAM_SHOWCASE, identify the ten heroes by CV and read the player names by OCR, and show them in the deck only. The owner accepts the copyright risk of using hero images for local identification and states nothing leaves the machine. Conditions set by the integration lead to keep the decision safe: (1) player names (ranks only if trivial) are read locally, held in memory for the current match only, never written to disk, logs or crash reports, never put into events, announcer text, clips, share exports or any projection, cleared at match end, with a visible setting to turn names off; (2) reference portraits are built at runtime from the user's installed game files read-only (no game memory, no injection) and no Valve art is committed or shipped; if that is infeasible the options are reported instead of bundling; (3) low confidence is shown as unknown, never guessed; (4) CPU and GPU cost is measured and reported, no limit set (DEC-RESOURCE-BUDGET); (5) 1920x1080 at 100 percent only, else unsupported with the real reason; (6) same duplicated frame, second sub-rectangle, only in the draft phases. Not decided here: any enemy or ally data from other sources, sharing, storage of names, and the contract text for third-party data, which must be written and versioned before the names path ships (SECURITY-PRIVACY: other players' data needs a separately versioned contract and permission change). Revision 2 (owner, 2026-11-23): each top-bar slot (Radiant 0-4, Dire 0-4) is an independent per-slot profile whose CV results fail independently. Besides the hero (5b) and the player name (5c, unchanged and not yet built), a profile carries the player colour read from the draft colour strip (5d) and, for the owner's own team only, the lane role label (5e; fixed vocabulary safe lane, mid lane, off lane, support, hard support; unknown when unsure). The own slot is derived only from the GSI own team and own hero matched to a uniquely identified slot hero, never from screen position. Colours and lane roles are not personal data but follow the same lifetime and forbidden sinks: memory only, cleared at match end and on session change, shown in the control-window deck. Lane-role icon references are built at runtime from the installed game files like the portraits. Nothing about names changes.

decisions.decision: Approve the left-edge orb as a vertical three-channel mixer (Dota process, Kohbor announcer, user-selected music) with adjustable Focus mode, default 20%, and optional off-by-default hotkey. Reveal after an adjustable 1 s dwell by scaling 80% to 100%; accept clicks only after reveal. Every orb/panel click uses a built-in foreground activation guard. Any detected activation closes the panel, restores click-through and hides the orb until match end. Acceptance requires at least 30 interactions in normal live or bot matches with zero activation_detected; induced activation fails closed. Keep the outer 8 px click-through, Dota keyboard focus, passive overlay/HUD, critical-alert preemption and Settings off switch. Per-application volume is limited to Dota and user-selected music apps; no input injection, process memory/file access or network.
decisions.reason: Reduce the need to switch windows for audio and overlay controls while preserving Dota input and critical cues.
alternatives_considered: Reveal only when dead or paused
decisions.safe_interim: Keep the orb unavailable until the built-in focus guard and native acceptance are implemented and verified. Any activation fails closed for the rest of that match. Settings can disable the extension.
decisions.closure_evidence: Owner approved all 11 CR answers on 2026-11-21. Native focus, volume restore and acceptance evidence remain NOT_RUN.

decisions.decision: 1. Rename "สรุปผล" to Analytics while retaining the route. This is a feature-specific exception to the AGENTS.md default against cloud data and paid services. The Analytics chat may call Anthropic Claude Messages API only with the user own API key, after explicit consent, while AI is enabled; AI starts off, can be revoked, and sends nothing automatically. The only content sent is derived selected-match context, hero names, the user question, the earlier user and assistant messages of the same match chat (resent unchanged with each question; owner 2026-11-24: "Yes, resend them") and open-document text. Player names, Steam/account IDs, raw match ID and file paths are never sent. The API key is never content: it goes only to api.anthropic.com in the HTTPS x-api-key authentication header. The user pays Anthropic directly; Kohbor adds no account, server, telemetry or billing. Without key, consent or AI enablement, no request occurs and local template fallback remains available. 3. Automatically analyse discovered replays only outside matches, one at a time under existing engine admission. Keep newest 20 analysed bundles plus every pinned "เก็บไว้" bundle by default, with a 2 GiB size cap. Eviction never deletes source .dem files, notes or chat. 4. Amendment DEC-AI-PROVIDERS (owner decision 2026-11-24, owner words “Approve 1–7”): the Analytics chat supports Anthropic, OpenAI Platform API key, OpenRouter, Google Gemini, xAI Grok, DeepSeek, Qwen (DashScope compatible mode), user-run Ollama, LiteLLM, and a user-entered OpenAI-compatible endpoint, using API keys only and no ChatGPT subscription login. Unverified providers are hidden by default until an owner-side verified flag is set after a recorded live test; an off-by-default Developer-mode toggle reveals unverified rows without verifying them. Provider consent is per provider and origin; keys are DPAPI-protected per provider and bound to origin. User endpoints are HTTPS or HTTP loopback only, redirects are never followed, and local providers are never started by Kohbor. AI questions are blocked during draft, pregame and live phases. Switching providers in an existing match chat warns that earlier messages and old-provider answers will be sent to the new company. Anthropic keeps its closed three-model list; other providers allow typed model IDs and explicit fetch. A user-pressed “บันทึกเป็นโน้ต” fallback is used when tools are unavailable. No ChatGPT subscription sign-in is supported.
